description: This file provides the implementation of a checkpoint writing mechanism for distributed machine learning models in PyTorch. It defines classes for configuring the checkpoint writer, handling checkpoint write operations, and providing hooks for custom pre- and post-commit actions. The code facilitates synchronized checkpointing across multiple distributed processes using barriers.

classes.name: WriterHook
classes.description: Abstract base class for checkpoint commit hooks, allowing users to define custom actions before and after checkpoint commits.

classes.name: CheckpointWriterConfig
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for checkpoint writer options, currently supporting a barrier timeout setting.

classes.name: CheckpointWriter
classes.description: Main class responsible for writing model state dictionaries to storage, coordinating with barriers and hooks to ensure proper checkpointing behavior in distributed settings.

methods.name: None pre_commit(self, path: str, **kwargs: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Hook method called before a checkpoint is committed; intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: None post_commit(self, path: str, **kwargs: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Hook method called after a checkpoint is committed; intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: Future[None]|None write( self, path: str, state_dict: STATE_DICT, **kwargs: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Performs the process of saving the checkpoint to disk, executing hooks, and synchronizing across ranks.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Method for cleaning up resources; a no-op in the base class.
